entities.title: Submissions
entities.summary: Names are cleaned, a submission's shape is checked, and scores come from the issued seed.
criteria: Names are cleaned to plain letters, digits, spaces and . - ' _, at most 12 characters
A submission needs one name or null per player, and no name without a usable character or over 200 characters
score() gives every player's score and wave as the game played them, from the issued seed
A recording that runs past the game's end does not score

checks.symbol: the server's helpers: names, submissions, and scores from the issued seed

entities.details: The routes themselves (the database, 409 for a used seed, ranks) and the scores page have no automated check.

entities.title: Sign-in
entities.summary: The page and the score API need a sign-in; the vendored library is unedited.
criteria: Someone signed out is sent to sign in, and back
The page is served privately to anyone signed in
A new game or a score needs a sign-in, and an unreachable login service counts as signed out

checks.symbol: sign-in: the game's page sends someone signed out to sign in, and back
sign-in: the page is served to anyone signed in, privately
sign-in: a new game or a score needs a sign-in; the login service out of reach is signed out
sign-in: the vendored library (shared by every game here) is icelander.net's, unedited

entities.details: Shatterbelt's own suite does not check the vendored library; Rally's does, for the one copy every game imports.
